description: IRS Form 1040, U.S. Individual Income Tax Return, pages 1 and 2

tax_year.description: The tax year printed in the form header, e.g. 2025

first_name_and_initial.description: Your first name and middle initial, as printed

ssn.description: Your social security number, as NNN-NN-NNNN

spouse.description: The spouse, on a joint return

first_name_and_initial.description: Spouse's first name and middle initial, as printed

ssn.description: Spouse's social security number, as NNN-NN-NNNN

filing_status.description: The Filing Status box that is checked. Only one box may be checked

digital_assets.description: Answer to the Digital Assets question: 'yes' if the Yes box is checked, 'no' if the No box is checked

wages_w2_box1.description: Line 1a: total amount from Form(s) W-2, box 1, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_earned_income.description: Line 1z: add lines 1a through 1h, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

tax_exempt_interest.description: Line 2a: tax-exempt interest, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

taxable_interest.description: Line 2b: taxable interest, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

qualified_dividends.description: Line 3a: qualified dividends, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

ordinary_dividends.description: Line 3b: ordinary dividends, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

ira_distributions_taxable.description: Line 4b: IRA distributions, taxable amount, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

pensions_taxable.description: Line 5b: pensions and annuities, taxable amount, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

social_security_taxable.description: Line 6b: social security benefits, taxable amount, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

capital_gain_or_loss.description: Line 7a: capital gain or (loss), in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

additional_income_schedule_1.description: Line 8: additional income from Schedule 1, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_income.description: Line 9: total income, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

adjustments_to_income.description: Line 10: adjustments to income from Schedule 1, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

adjusted_gross_income.description: Line 11a: adjusted gross income, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

tax_and_credits.description: Tax and Credits section, page 2, lines 11b to 24

standard_or_itemized_deduction.description: Line 12e: standard deduction or itemized deductions, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

qualified_business_income_deduction.description: Line 13a: qualified business income deduction, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_deductions.description: Line 14: add lines 12e, 13a and 13b, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

taxable_income.description: Line 15: taxable income, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

tax.description: Line 16: tax, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_tax_before_credits.description: Line 18: add lines 16 and 17, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

child_tax_credit.description: Line 19: child tax credit or credit for other dependents, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

schedule_3_credits.description: Line 20: amount from Schedule 3, line 8, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_credits.description: Line 21: add lines 19 and 20, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_tax.description: Line 24: total tax, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

payments.description: Payments and Refundable Credits section, lines 25 to 33

withholding_w2.description: Line 25a: federal income tax withheld from Form(s) W-2, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

withholding_1099.description: Line 25b: federal income tax withheld from Form(s) 1099, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_withholding.description: Line 25d: add lines 25a through 25c, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

estimated_tax_payments.description: Line 26: estimated tax payments and amount applied from prior year, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

earned_income_credit.description: Line 27a: earned income credit, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

total_payments.description: Line 33: total payments, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

overpaid.description: Line 34: amount overpaid, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

refund_amount.description: Line 35a: amount refunded to you, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

routing_number.description: Line 35b: direct deposit routing number. Null if blank

account_type.description: Line 35c: the account type whose box is checked ([x]). Null if both the Checking and Savings boxes are unchecked ([ ])

applied_to_next_year.description: Line 36: amount applied to next year's estimated tax, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line

amount_owed.description: Line 37: amount you owe, in USD. Null if the amount cell for this line is empty; never write 0 for an empty line
